mapper.sql: id, member_id, record_date, distance_km, duration_seconds, pace_seconds_per_km, average_cadence, average_heart_rate_bpm, memo, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO running_records ( member_id, record_date, distance_km, duration_seconds, pace_seconds_per_km, average_cadence, average_heart_rate_bpm, memo ) VALUES ( #{memberId}, #{recordDate}, #{distanceKm}, #{durationSeconds}, #{paceSecondsPerKm}, #{averageCadence}, #{averageHeartRateBpm}, #{memo} )
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM running_records WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY record_date DESC, id DESC
SELECT average_heart_rate_bpm FROM running_records WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND average_heart_rate_bpm IS NOT NULL AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY record_date DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT average_cadence FROM running_records WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND average_cadence IS NOT NULL AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY record_date DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT
FROM running_records WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE running_records SET record_date = #{recordDate}, distance_km = #{distanceKm}, duration_seconds = #{durationSeconds}, pace_seconds_per_km = #{paceSecondsPerKm}, average_cadence = #{averageCadence}, average_heart_rate_bpm = #{averageHeartRateBpm}, memo = #{memo} WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE running_records SET deleted_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
